name: RankWatch
description_en:
RankWatch is a product in the Search optimization category. Its directory profile covers User Management, Revenue Management, Rank Tracking, Mobile Search Tracking, Link Management, Keyword Tracking, Google Analytics Integration, Content Management.

Additional listed capabilities include Competitor Analysis, Auditing, Dashboard. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $26.00.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: manage application users and their access settings; track reported search positions over time; monitor recorded search positions for selected queries; organize content through creation, revision and publication; compare selected publicly available product or marketing signals; bring selected indicators and records into one view. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
RankWatch 属于搜索优化软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括用户管理、收入管理、排名跟踪、移动搜索跟踪、链接管理、关键词跟踪、Google Analytics 集成、内容管理。

资料还列出竞品分析、审计、仪表盘。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $26.00.。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：管理应用用户及其访问设置；跟踪一段时间内记录到的搜索位置；监测选定查询词的已记录搜索位置；组织内容的创建、修订和发布；比较选定的公开产品或营销信息；在同一视图中汇集选定指标和记录。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
